reviewMethod: Each selected stored file was independently re-hashed from the frozen GitHub evidence archive and visually inspected against its owning caption and paper theme. Task/page/article/source DOI binding, original figure identity, capture protocol 6.2.20, fixed media generation, direct ACS article/source paths, image role, clarity, duplicate/same-ID publication risk and current-corpus continuity were checked. All selected SVGs were checked for self-contained references and absence of active script/foreignObject content; PNG signatures and dimensions were checked against the stored metadata. Capture success and review markers were treated only as provenance evidence. Partial article-level captures were not expanded beyond the exact individually verified stored files. No publisher recrawl, R2 write, server-side direct import/repair, literature-data change or userscript change was performed. The sixth remaining paper in the frozen evidence set was intentionally deferred to preserve the five-paper semantic-review cap for this round.
